rooms.name: The Headshell
rooms.notes: Home. The empty grip stays on screen. Spindle junction I.
rooms.first: Wriggle-out. The grip. Junction I, dormant until connected on foot.
rooms.revisit: After B1 the room re-reads: Rite = the arm comes home, grip open. Force = the cradle stays empty forever.

rooms.name: The Horn Plaza
rooms.notes: The great horn + the Hound. Hooded stillness here = the horn's only sound.
rooms.first: The Hound; stillness-pets taught; the horn's plaque reads the Voice's runtime: 'all of it.'
rooms.revisit: The horn trick (hooded stillness = its only sound, ever). The Hound's patrol grows with each mercy.

rooms.name: Rooms To Let
rooms.notes: Matron 33 1/3. Heal/save. Sleeve-patch armor.
rooms.first: Save/heal. Matron's rotation begins.
rooms.revisit: Ribbon -> sleeve-patch armor. The seventh phrase fires here after Addie.

rooms.name: The High Street
rooms.notes: Parry tutorial Looper. The Postie, Almost There. 2nd-run LIFT door in the loft.
rooms.first: Parry-tutorial Looper. The Postie, Almost There. The loft's LIFT-door, visible and unexplained.
rooms.revisit: The loft (stealth from minute one, or Gather later): overlook + bootleg. After the Postie is freed, the letter completes and the street changes state.

rooms.name: The Print Shop
rooms.notes: The Typesetter. Shine for map pages. TOMORROW: THE VOICE, CONT'D.
rooms.first: The Typesetter; shine -> map pages; today's poster for tomorrow.
rooms.revisit: New margin-marker stock each act. Break-pattern line after the Welcome.

rooms.name: The Practice Room
rooms.notes: Tick loops on 3. COUNT-IN chalked on the metronome.
rooms.first: COUNT-IN chalked beside Tick's loop.
rooms.revisit: Tick's Rite (their '4' is learned in the Whisper Strata) -> freed Tick + the on-beat aura.

rooms.name: The Stalls
rooms.notes: Dry market. Strike-launch lessons. Glass cases.
rooms.first: Strike-launch lessons; the glass cases tease the cache.
rooms.revisit: Gather opens the high shelf; the cache glass only breaks ON BEAT.

rooms.name: The Locked-Groove Yard
rooms.notes: Graveyard of one-bar loops. Chalked worn names. Addie's answer + the arm's charge live here.
rooms.first: Worn names in chalk. Addie's answer. The arm's charge (both halves).
rooms.revisit: Under REST-quiet the faintest graves speak: three more listens; one of them says the name Vess.

rooms.name: The Descent Gate
rooms.notes: Label exit. A groove-lock listens for the Count-In.
rooms.first: The Count-In gate; the stutter at its loudest in Act 1 (listening spot).
rooms.revisit: Stays open: the town <-> Overture loop.

rooms.name: Label Balcony
rooms.notes: Dead-air balcony. Gather-only in Act 1. Stared at from below.
rooms.first: Seen from below all act. Unreachable. A promise.
rooms.revisit: Gather (Act 2) = the climb. The town seen from above; the book takes a full page.

rooms.name: Stall Cache
rooms.notes: Behind the glass. A bootleg nobody labeled.

rooms.name: The Unsigned Alcove
rooms.notes: The unsigned groove-lock. 'you knew. that's the whole game.'

rooms.name: The Overture Stair
rooms.notes: The long way down. Worn thin; the walls whistle faintly.
rooms.first: The Worn introduced: noise hurts them; quiet is kinder.
rooms.revisit: Gather alcove: a shine cluster, and a Worn who bows if you pass hooded.

rooms.name: The Bootlegger's Stall
rooms.notes: Unfolds from the wall. Tapes in worn names only. Don't touch the B-sides.
rooms.first: The stall unfolds. The economy opens. Don't touch the B-sides.
rooms.revisit: Stock grows each act. Break-pattern after Vess's answer is given.

rooms.name: The Whistlers
rooms.notes: Grooves worn so thin the wind plays them. One-way sound-jets.
rooms.first: One-way wind-jets; the cage visible above.
rooms.revisit: Gather rides the jets both ways. The Jump-Cut shatters the cage roof: the Flue shortcut.

rooms.name: Addie's Doorway
rooms.notes: Adagio in C, 14:13-17:13. The first mercy.
rooms.first: The first mercy (full scene).
rooms.revisit: Freed Addie putters here. She pats the hood. Nothing is taught twice; it's just kind here, on purpose.

rooms.name: The Overture Well
rooms.notes: Vertical drop; wall-groove zigzag on the climb back.
rooms.first: Vertical drop; wall-groove zigzag on the climb back.
rooms.revisit: A bootleg wedged in the wall crack, findable only climbing UP.

rooms.name: The Worn Gallery
rooms.notes: Ghost-thin echoes. The Worn drift here; quiet is kinder.
rooms.first: The Worn drift; hooded-walk teaching corridor.
rooms.revisit: Post-B1: the arm's drag-marks cross the floor. One Worn follows them back and forth, confused.

rooms.name: The Smoothed Floor
rooms.notes: HUSH DUEL I. Burnished mirror-flat. 'go home.'
rooms.first: HUSH DUEL I. The room is the tutorial: no resonance anywhere.
rooms.revisit: After the Welcome a new note appears: 'it spoke to you. don't listen.'

rooms.name: The Arm
rooms.notes: B1: THE TONEARM. It points up once. It never swings first.
rooms.first: B1. It points up once. It never swings first.
rooms.revisit: After: the seal stands open. The room stays quiet in a way no other room does.

rooms.name: The Whistler Cage
rooms.notes: A cage that was never opened. The Jump-Cut shatters its roof.

rooms.name: The Flue
rooms.notes: Shortcut chimney: Whistlers straight up to the Stalls. Cuts ~20 min.

rooms.name: The Drop
rooms.notes: The wound, crossed from inside. One-way on first pass. The reveal.
rooms.first: The reveal (S1-S8).
rooms.revisit: Gather climb inside the wound: shine veins, and a listening spot -- the night of the skip, in fragments. The Last Playback, teased.

rooms.name: The Landing
rooms.notes: Soft arrival on burnished wax. Title card. Spindle junction II.
rooms.first: Title card. Junction II. Cue point.
rooms.revisit: Hub. The burnished patch is still there every time; the book eventually admits whose work it is.

rooms.name: The Verse Hall
rooms.notes: Westward. Narrow and wordy; meaning nobody heard.
rooms.first: Auditioners introduced -- and the mercy exit with them. First 'soon.' on a wall.
rooms.revisit: A cracked wall opens ON BEAT -> the Verse Crawl. West mouth of the Undercross loop.

rooms.name: Auditioner Warren (N)
rooms.notes: They reach for you. SET-play one and it leaves happy.
rooms.first: Warren proper; SET-mercy as economy of time vs health.
rooms.revisit: Post-B2 the warrens go quiet: Auditioners gather at the Hand-Off door, listening.

rooms.name: The Deep Gallery
rooms.notes: Vess's unplayed answer sleeps here. SET only.
rooms.first: Vess's unplayed answer sleeps here (SET only).
rooms.revisit: Post-Rite: the completed duet plays here, soft, forever.

rooms.name: Auditioner Warren (S)
rooms.notes: Deeper warren. Loopers teach their two honest bars.
rooms.first: Loopers: the honest rhythm teachers.
rooms.revisit: A collapsed side-pocket digs open ON BEAT.

rooms.name: The Hand-Off
rooms.notes: B2: THE DUET. The arena is his hearing. Mandatory stealth.
rooms.first: B2: THE DUET. The arena is his hearing.
rooms.revisit: Post-Rite tableau: the bow, held. Auditioners at the door.

rooms.name: The Chorus Hall
rooms.notes: Eastward. The hook hums from below.
rooms.first: The hook, audible. First Earworm ambush.
rooms.revisit: Sluice #1 of the pool-drain puzzle.

rooms.name: The Hook Pools
rooms.notes: Trance-thick loops. Earworm territory. do NOT soak. ok five minutes.
rooms.first: Trance pools: soak = drift. Earworm territory.
rooms.revisit: Sluices #2-3. Drained state = new floor, and the tab glyphs show on the emptied basin walls.

rooms.name: Walt's Ballroom
rooms.notes: Waltz in E-flat, mid-spin. Freed: teaches the step-turn.
rooms.first: Walt, mid-spin, arms around no one.
rooms.revisit: His Rite -> the STEP-TURN (the game's one taught movement tech). After: he dances the dust into rings; shine trickles.

rooms.name: The Gather Chalk
rooms.notes: GATHER, chalked at the pools' bottom. Air, anywhere. The retraversal key.
rooms.first: GATHER, chalked at the pools' bottom. Air, anywhere.
rooms.revisit: On return the book notices the chalk hand: hers.

rooms.name: The Undercross
rooms.notes: The long corridor linking both lobes under the Landing. The Act 2 loop.
rooms.first: Skippers introduced. 'soon.' at its densest.
rooms.revisit: The Act 2 loop road. Post-Welcome: everything re-chalked, fresh. A bootleg in a dead pipe.

rooms.name: The Mechanism
rooms.notes: B3: THE CHANGER. No grief, no Rite, no stealth. The exam.
rooms.first: B3: THE CHANGER. The exam.
rooms.revisit: Its corpse becomes a ladder: arm-platforms open the Welcome Gate <-> Undercross shortcut.

rooms.name: The Verse Crawl
rooms.notes: A crushed passage. A Last-Bar fragment hums inside.

rooms.name: The Drain Tab
rooms.notes: Drain the Hook Pools in the right order and they play this room open.

rooms.name: The Welcome Gate
rooms.notes: THE WELCOME. The fall stops. It says thank you.
rooms.first: THE WELCOME (full scene).
rooms.revisit: Soon's hold-pockets linger: free air-stalls -- the villain's touch, used as traversal.

rooms.name: The Bassline (W)
rooms.notes: Swimming galleries. Strike = jet. Spindle junction III.
rooms.first: Swimming taught for real. Junction III.
rooms.revisit: REST stills the current: the side gallery opens.

rooms.name: The Bassline (E)
rooms.notes: Undertow currents. Feral Chords harmonize in the dark.
rooms.first: Undertow; Feral Chords harmonize in the dark.
rooms.revisit: REST-gated nest at the far end.

rooms.name: The Whisper Strata
rooms.notes: The lore column. Everything each mourner lost, audible in full stillness. REST learned here.
rooms.first: The lore column: what every mourner lost, audible only in full stillness. REST is learned here.
rooms.revisit: Returns pay all game: the Digger's runtime, Tick's '4', her practice sessions -- and the cue: the way her hand fell.

rooms.name: The Sump
rooms.notes: Central sink. Both basslines drain here.
rooms.first: The sink. Pressure introduced; both basslines drain through.
rooms.revisit: Post-B4: the freed tracks rise through this room for the rest of the game.

rooms.name: The Quiet Gallery
rooms.notes: HUSH DUEL II. 'footwork. the deep is worse.'
rooms.first: HUSH DUEL II. 'footwork. the deep is worse.'
rooms.revisit: The note under fresh burnish. Later, in perfect stillness: one bar, practiced, barely audible. [played]

rooms.name: The Mispress
rooms.notes: Wrong grooves. The world's one manufacturing error.
rooms.first: Wrong grooves: a pocket of misbehaving physics.
rooms.revisit: The wrongness resonates when you carry the Jump-Cut. A ribbon in a mispressed bubble.

rooms.name: Deep Cue Point
rooms.notes: A cue point. The Hound finds you even here. Do not ask how.
rooms.first: A cue point. The Hound finds you even here.
rooms.revisit: Do not ask how. (The book asks how. No answer.)

rooms.name: The Crates
rooms.notes: B4: THE DIGGER. It kept everyone.
rooms.first: B4: THE DIGGER. It kept everyone.
rooms.revisit: The crates stand open after; the freed drift upward. Its own tape sits on top of the emptied hoard.
rewards: bootleg:EVERYTHING I KEPT (side a of infinity)

rooms.name: The Mispress Core
rooms.notes: The JUMP-CUT, etched by no hand she'd approve of. It hurts a little.

rooms.name: The Green Room
rooms.notes: NOW SERVING: infinity. NEXT: ________. The Threshold. Cross by choosing to stop waiting.
rooms.first: THE THRESHOLD (full scene). NOW SERVING: infinity.

rooms.name: The Cradle-Lathe
rooms.notes: Where styli were cast. Where you are from. Where he is from. One listening spot: your casting-day.
rooms.first: The casting-day listening spot. 'you were made here. both of you.'

rooms.name: The Locked Grooves
rooms.notes: The deep graveyard. Chalk in a hand you don't recognize. (His.)
rooms.first: The never-played graves, chalked in a hand you don't recognize. One wedged note: 'i chalked their names. someone had to.'

rooms.name: The Runout
rooms.notes: B5: THE UNHEARD, conducted by SOON. The kindness audit, face to face.
rooms.first: B5: the Unheard, conducted by Soon. The audit, face to face.

rooms.name: The Etching
rooms.notes: Her signature, and the last line before it. The signature isn't hers alone.
rooms.first: Her signature, and the last line before it.

rooms.name: The Last Bar
rooms.notes: One input. Hold as long as you dare. The last input is a release.
rooms.first: One input. Hold as long as you dare.
